newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT-U.S. debt futures trade in middle of range.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-U.S. debt futures trade in middle of range.

text.p: * U.S. debt futures continued to trade in the middle of a 2-1/2-week range.
* Traders and analysts said the only fundamental factor that could push March T-bonds or June Eurodollars out of their ranges was next Tuesday's U.S. fourth-quarter employment cost index.
On the contrary, the T-bond futures market's attempts to rally have been met with selling.
March T-bonds' rally on Thursday in reaction to the weekly U.S. jobless claims data ended with heavy selling once the contract hit 111-07/32, traders said.
March T-bonds soon fell through 111-00 to 110-29/32. The contract fell to 110-27/32 in early overnight dealings.
Like bonds, June Eurodollars found little inspiration to test resistance at 94.24.

Many traders and analysts said at this point the only fundamental factor that could shake bonds or Eurodollars out of their ranges would be the U.S. fourth-quarter employment cost index, due out on Tuesday, January 28.
